name: Tradogram
summary: Tradogram sells purchasing software in three tiers. Essentials costs $99 a month, or $950.40 a year, and includes purchase orders and supplier management. Requisitions and custom approval routing are add-ons on Essentials and come with the quoted Premium and Scale plans.

facts.text: Purchase orders and supplier management are in every plan, while requisitions and custom approval routing are add-ons on Essentials.
The vendor management page says new vendors complete onboarding through a self-service vendor portal and submit contact details, documents and pricing once.
Single sign-on, API access, ERP and accounting integrations and PunchOut are paid add-ons on any plan.
The homepage names AICPA SOC, ISO 27001, PCI DSS and GDPR only in the alt text of a badge image and gives no scope or status.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Annual billing is $950.40 a year, which is 20% off. Purchase orders, supplier management, AP invoices, expenses and mobile apps. An extra-user fee applies and the amount is not published

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: For 20 or more users. Adds requisitions, sourcing RFx, receiving, budgets, contracts and custom approvals

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Unlimited users, custom SLA and multi-region hosting

hiddenCosts: Essentials charges an additional user fee that the pricing page does not state.
Requisitions, receiving, budgets and custom approvals are paid add-ons on Essentials, with no add-on prices published.
Single sign-on and API access are add-ons on every plan.
